nodes.label: Character Portrait (Mateo / Detective faces)
nodes.rationale: Two SVG faces in one portrait so the HUD can swap between Mateo (memory role) and the detective without new assets

nodes.label: Game HTML Shell Template
nodes.rationale: Single-file template with __CSP__, __CSS__ and __BUNDLE__ placeholders so the build inlines styles and the JS module bundle into one self-contained page

nodes.label: Case Files / Dossiers
nodes.rationale: Stacked, string-tied folders and boxed records foreshadow document-driven investigation of a redacted record.

nodes.label: Detective's Office Interior
nodes.rationale: Desk with tied case-file bundle, loose papers, pen cup, banker's lamp, filing cabinets, wooden chairs and a half-open door.

nodes.label: Trench-Coated Detective Silhouette
nodes.rationale: Faceless figure in fedora and belted trench coat seen from behind, a player-avatar stand-in that invites projection.

nodes.label: Framed Caduceus Certificate
nodes.rationale: Medical caduceus emblem on the wall hints the 'donor' mystery has a medical or organ-donation dimension.

nodes.label: Rain-Soaked Night Cityscape
nodes.rationale: Rain streaks past venetian blinds onto a skyline with water towers, smokestacks and a gothic tower; classic 1940s noir setting.

nodes.label: Sepia Engraved Noir Art Style
nodes.rationale: Monochrome amber palette, cross-hatched engraving texture and venetian-blind light shafts define the game's visual identity.

nodes.label: Title Screen Key Art (title.jpg)
nodes.rationale: Sepia/amber noir illustration used as the title cover; establishes the hardboiled detective mood before play begins.

nodes.label: Detective and Rescued Woman Walking Out
nodes.norm_label: detective and rescued woman walking out
nodes.rationale: A man in a herringbone trench coat (the detective) walks beside a woman in a 1940s suit carrying a book or ledger, both leaving through open doors toward the harbour - depicts the rescued victim/witness freed alive.

nodes.label: Harbour at Dawn Setting
nodes.rationale: Waterfront promenade with domed civic building, gas lamp, vintage car, steamship, crane, bollard and seagull under a rising sun; dawn contrasts with the game's night-time noir palette.

nodes.label: Hospital / Clinic Doorway (Red Cross Emblem)
nodes.rationale: The cross emblem on the wall marks the building being exited as a hospital or clinic - the site of the organ-trafficking operation - so walking out symbolises escape from it.

nodes.label: 1940s Sepia Engraving Style
nodes.rationale: Cross-hatched, sepia-toned period illustration matching a vintage newspaper print aesthetic for the ending screen.

nodes.label: Rescue Ending Key Art (rescue.jpg)
nodes.rationale: Sepia engraving-style illustration used on the rescue/ending newspaper screen; warm dawn light and open doors signal resolution and release after the noir investigation.

nodes.label: WANTED Poster Easter Egg (last seen at the Oak Hackathon)
nodes.norm_label: wanted poster easter egg (last seen at the oak hackathon)

nodes.label: Wanted Poster Easter Egg Portrait Photo
nodes.norm_label: wanted poster easter egg portrait photo

nodes.label: Icon Sprite Sheet (icons.svg)
nodes.rationale: Fragment of 20 bare <symbol> elements with no <svg> root wrapper or <use> references, so it is meant to be inlined into a host document as an SVG sprite. The file itself does not name its consumer, so whether the game still loads it cannot be determined from this file alone.

nodes.label: Icon sprite usage not determinable from file
nodes.norm_label: icon sprite usage not determinable from file
nodes.rationale: The SVG contains only <symbol id=...> definitions and names no consuming code; whether the game still references these icons is unknown from this file.

nodes.label: Abandoned Detective Office
nodes.rationale: Setting: wooden filing cabinets with label slots, bookshelves of stacked files, an empty desk and bentwood chair, plank floor lit by a shaft of light. The empty chair implies the detective is gone.

nodes.label: Sepia-Red Noir Engraving Style
nodes.rationale: Cross-hatched woodcut or engraving rendering in a limited palette of sepia, cream and oxblood red, consistent with the game's noir visual identity.

nodes.label: Uniformed Officer Behind Frosted Door
nodes.rationale: Silhouette of a peaked-cap police officer under a hanging lamp behind the frosted-glass office door; reads as the authorities arriving to close the case or arrest the detective.

nodes.label: Cracked Pocket Watch
nodes.rationale: Foreground brass pocket watch with chain, its glass face shattered; the hands read roughly ten past ten. Symbolises time running out and the collapse of the investigation.

nodes.label: Collapse Key Art (game-over illustration)
nodes.rationale: Noir engraving-style illustration in sepia and blood-red tones shown on the game-over screen: a cracked pocket watch lying on a detective's office floor while a uniformed officer's silhouette waits behind the frosted-glass door, signalling that the investigation's time has run out and the detective has been caught or shut down.
